hooks.excerpt: CHOOSE WISELY AND ELEVATE YOUR ABILITIES In each run, strategic choices await as you accumulate experience and select perks to enhance your prowess. Elevate these perks to unlock augmented versions, granting you additional abilities that turn the tide of battle in your favor.
